name: CopyButton
summary: Copies a value to the clipboard and confirms it once: the icon turns to a check and a hidden status says Copied.
useWhen: A command, a link, an id or a color the person will paste somewhere else
Beside a code block or a read only field that shows the value
An icon only copy control next to its value, named by label
avoidWhen: The value is long text the person edits first
Copying needs a choice of format
The value is not shown anywhere on the page

insteadUse.Share a link to people: Button that opens a share Dialog
insteadUse.Edit then copy: Input with a CopyButton at its end

label.description: The action name: visible text, or the accessible name with iconOnly. Copy, or نسخ under an Arabic Theme. Name what is copied when it helps: Copy command.

iconOnly.description: Shows only the icon; label becomes the accessible name.

copiedLabel.description: What the status says after a copy (تم النسخ in Arabic).

failedLabel.description: What the status says after a failure (تعذر النسخ in Arabic).

target.description: The id of the element that shows the value. A failed copy selects its text, so the keyboard can copy it.

onCopied.description: Called with the value after it reached the clipboard.

onCopyFailed.description: Called with the value after the copy failed.

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px in the default density. A ButtonGroup passes its size; this prop wins.

emphasis.description: ghost: a copy control sits beside the value it copies.

shape.description: default takes radius.control (Desk draws it as a pill), pill is fully round, square takes radius.sm.

a11y.focus: In the tab order. Focus stays on the button through the copy.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the next control

a11y.announce: A visually hidden status inside the button says Copied, or Could not copy, once per copy (WCAG 4.1.3), and is emptied when the button returns to idle. No native title.
notes: The Clipboard API is called inside the click handler. Where it is missing or refused, a hidden textarea and the copy command are tried; if both fail, the state is failed and the target text is selected.
The result shows for delay.peek-hide, then the button returns to idle. Hold time, not motion: it is kept under reduced motion.
The result is not told by color alone: the icon changes from copy to check or warning, and the status says it.

en.label: Copy, or Copy plus the thing: Copy command, Copy link.

ar.label: نسخ، أو نسخ مع الشيء: نسخ الرابط.

react.behavior: native button on ButtonBase, Clipboard API

angular.behavior: button[dsCopyButton] on DsButtonBase, the clipboard inside the click handler
angular.note: onCopied and onCopyFailed are the copied and copyFailed outputs. A (click) of the caller that calls preventDefault cancels the copy, as onClick does in React. The copy logic is a copy of the React copy.ts until it moves to packages/shared.

styles.studio: Ghost by default; the check in the success color, the warning in the danger color.
styles.desk: Pill shaped; the same result colors.

mistakes.right: The check and the hidden status of CopyButton

mistakes.wrong: A copy button with no visible value nearby
mistakes.right: Show the value, and pass its id as target

mistakes.wrong: A title tooltip that says Copied
mistakes.right: The status part; a Tooltip arrives in wave 1
